Class Restaurant

java.lang.Object
lt.viko.eif.dalencinovic.first.spring.model.BaseEntity
lt.viko.eif.dalencinovic.first.spring.model.Restaurant
@Entity public class Restaurant extends BaseEntity
Represents a restaurant entity in the system. This class is used as JPA entity for database persistence and JAXB model for XML serialization/deserialization A restaurant contains general information such as name, location, status, rating, and a list of menu items.
